run_create_uma_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to create a UMA finetune dataset from ASE atoms directories with energy or force regression tasks
create_yaml_finetune_configs: create YAML configuration files for UMA model finetuning with specified train and validation dataset paths
launch_processing_ase_atoms: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms object directories into fairchem dataset format for training
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
refactor_create_yaml_regression_tasks: refactor create_yaml to support additional regression task types beyond energy, force, and stress
